correction: chairlift was counted as started from a `chairlift --first-run` process. Only the user journal line `first-run: window presented` proves a presented window, so a bare --first-run process no longer counts, and first-setup keeps the two-consecutive-polls rule.

login-1 stopped observing after the first started app plus one poll, so an app (or chairlift's journal line) that started later was never seen. Both login boots now observe the full app_wait window and mark done only after it, with one bounded journal read after the window.

The host accepted any session object with short strings, so a tty, a greeter or a closing session could be read as a first login. login_record_shape now requires type wayland or x11, class user, state active or online, and a bounded desktop pattern, and every other string field stays pattern-bound.

SDDM reads /etc/sddm.conf after /etc/sddm.conf.d, so an active [Autologin] User= there won over the probe's zz- drop-in. login-setup.sh now comments out the active User=, Session= and Relogin= lines of that section (keeping the file mode, never creating the file), and the probe reports autologin false while such a line stays active.
